dsDescriptionValue.value:
The research project “Gezin en Persoonlijkheid” ("Personality and Family Relationships") was a temporary joint venture of four departments of the Faculties of Social Sciences of the University of Utrecht and the University of Nijmegen. Its principal goal was to study the transactional development of family relationships and personality in families with adolescent children. To this end a longitudinal data collection was designed and executed. In the project we studied 288 families in three measurement waves with an interval of one year, and using a cohort sequential design. In a round robin design family members gave self- and other ratings about their family relationships and relational support, personality, problem behavior, well being, identity and other.
Additionally, similar information was collected in best friends of family members in the second measurement wave.

On Language use:
The field data collections were done in Dutch. Variable and Value Labels in datafiles are in Dutch to maximize correspondence with data collection procedure and materials. Data guide, codebooks and metadata are predominantly in English.

value: Pen and paper questionnaires, individually filled in by 4 members of 288 families with adolescent children in three measurement waves with an interval of one year, as well as best friends of these family members in the second measurement wave.
